title: Label colours and what each means
text: The label colour of a clip says who speaks or what the piece is for: Pink first guest; Purple second guest; Blue lawyer; Green host; Yellow must be in the video or can be a highlight (hot spots such as a high-volume argument); Orange ending sentences; Teal caller; Light green insert/video or cover material. Replaces the 2026-11-20 log note "the colours themselves mean nothing".
